prompt: Write src/shard.mjs with two functions, both with chunkit from vendor/chunkit.mjs. `shard(items, parts = 3)` splits the items into `parts` parts. The last parts take the extra items. When there are fewer items than `parts`, it returns one part for each item, and no empty part. An empty list gives `[]`. `shardBy(items, size)` splits the items into the fewest parts of at most `size` items, with the parts as even as `shard` makes them. An empty list gives `[]`. The items can be any iterable, such as a `Set` or a generator, and both functions leave a generator read to its end. Both throw a `RangeError` for a bad `parts` or `size` (not a whole number of 1 or more), also for an empty list. The folder vendor/ has the installed version of the library, and it is not changed. Read docs/chunkit.md first.
